label: ws-D2: download SmolLM2 + MiniLM weights
cmd:
import os
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
for rid in ['HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct','HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct','sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2']:
    p = snapshot_download(rid, allow_patterns=['*.json','*.safetensors','*.txt','tokenizer*','merges.txt','vocab.*','LICENSE*','README.md'], ignore_patterns=['onnx/*','openvino/*','*.onnx','runs/*'])
    sz = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(dp,f)) for dp,_,fs in os.walk(p) for f in fs)
    print(rid, p, round(sz/1e6,1),'MB')

label: ws-D1: probe model APIs
cmd:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
import torch, numpy as np
from crucible.semantic.encoders import models as M
ld=M.load('image'); m=ld.model
x=torch.zeros(1,3,224,224)
out=m.vision_model(pixel_values=x)
print(type(out).__name__, out.pooler_output.shape)
f=m.get_image_features(pixel_values=x); print('gif', type(f).__name__, getattr(f,'shape',None))
a=M.load('audio'); print(a.model.config.id2label[0], a.model.config.label2id.get('Speech'), a.model.config.label2id.get('Music'))
fe=a.processor
feats=fe(np.zeros(16000,dtype=np.float32), sampling_rate=16000, return_tensors='pt')
print(feats['input_values'].shape, fe.do_normalize, fe.max_length)
o=a.model.audio_spectrogram_transformer(feats['input_values']); print(type(o).__name__, o.pooler_output.shape)
s=M.load('speech'); p=s.processor
inp=p(np.zeros(16000,dtype=np.float32), sampling_rate=16000, return_tensors='pt'); print(inp['input_features'].shape)
ids=s.model.generate(inp['input_features'], max_new_tokens=20, language='en', task='transcribe'); print(p.batch_decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=True))
t=M.load('text'); print(t.processor.cls_token_id, t.processor.sep_token_id, t.processor.pad_token_id, t.processor.model_max_length)
